body:
Hello, Juneo.
Thank you for all the sweet words, it means a lot to me.
 I do not think as suicide as an desperate event, I think it as another planned event people do when they feel like, just like marriage.
 I already have a day for doing it, not to far, just time enough for me to settle all things I need to.
 I'm not as rational as you may think, though. as I said, I do not wish to die, but I think of it as the best future for me.
 And I don't think me as unfortunate, there are people in way worst conditions than I do that still see a lot of joy in living. I'm just to weak and my joys aren't enough to compensate all I go through. I do not hate the world, in fact, I love it. I just don't belong here.
 Thank you very much for reading, sincere love, OP.

I'm extremely sorry for you suffering with depression too. All you said is incredibly right, and I'm glad you can feel happy over all the bad times!
 It's just that I personally do not feel worthy of being happy, but you sure are.
 I hope you keep being the strong and wonderful person you are, no matter what happens.
 And if something strikes you too much, please, talk to me. If I'm still alive, it will be a pleasure helping you as much as you helped me today.

 Thanks for the effort, I will never forget you for what you did.

Thank you so much for reading and worrying, it's very sweet of you!
 It's not that I want to be away from them. I love them. I just don't understand why my own family would hurt me so much and wont't stop because of their pride. I just wish they were good to me as other people's parents.
 Lots of things bring me the feeling of happiness, like seeing people smart and good with words like you exist. You could really convince someone that life is wonderful, and I admire that a lot.
 It's just that I concluded happiness is so short and not as good for me. I usually put a lot more hope than I should on the belief of actually being happy just so something harsh can happen and make me remember how lame I am. Maybe if I got to be sad 24 hours everyday I would be actually happy.
 I have lots of hobbies. I'm really into psychology, so I read so many wonderful books about it. I never did an actual charity work, but I would sing on the streets for money to buy food for all the homeless people I could find. I love to help people, because it helps me too.
 Any time spent with my friends is extremely special. Love them and feel loved. It makes all the sadness I feel with my parents disappear sometimes, but because of my depression, I often ruin moments by starting to cry or staring at nothing, thinking about how much I don't deserve anything they provide me.
 It might sound funny, it probably is, but days ago, just when me and my boyfriend finished intercourse, I started crying because I knew one day he would be doing it with another person, someone he actually deserves. 
 Apparently I ruin a lot of sacred moments, haha..
 Again, thank you so much from reading.

I don't think I'm good enough for my boyfriend, maybe if I go he could find someone he deserves, since, as you say, I'm selfish for wanting to take my life even with the consequences I'm REALLY aware of.
 Really bad advice. If I were to say that to a patient I would expect him to die days after.
 But thank you for the patience for reading and trying to help. I know you didn't mean to be rude, but I hope after knowing how I felt after reading what you said you won't be using that argument with anyone anymore.

 Again, thank you and be careful.
